label: 3D Reconstruction
description: Builds a web-ready, georeferenced 3D model (GLB) from whatever the task has: a textured terrain mesh from the DSM/DTM draped with the orthophoto, a surface or coloured points from the LAZ point cloud, or an optimised copy of ODM's own textured mesh with textures shrunk to a web budget. Detects the available inputs and picks the workflow automatically; opens in the 3D viewer.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: auto reuses the existing 3D model when the task has one (mesh), else builds a terrain mesh from the DSM/DTM (terrain), else from the point cloud (point-cloud). points exports the point cloud itself as coloured points.

quality.title: Quality profile
quality.description: Triangle, texture and point budgets. auto follows the task's ODM options (pc-quality, mesh-size, fast-orthophoto): web-lite 150k triangles / 2048 px, balanced 500k / 4096 px, high-detail 1.5M / 8192 px.

surface.title: Elevation source (terrain)
surface.description: dsm keeps buildings and trees; dtm gives the bare-earth terrain. Falls back to whichever the task has.

resolution_m.title: Mesh grid resolution (m)
resolution_m.description: Cell size of the elevation grid that is triangulated; 0 derives it from the triangle budget and the surveyed area.

max_triangles.title: Max triangles
max_triangles.description: Triangle budget after decimation; 0 uses the quality profile's value.

texture_size.title: Texture size (px)
texture_size.description: Longest side of the texture image (256-8192); 0 uses the quality profile's value. Never finer than the orthophoto itself.

texture_source.title: Texture source
texture_source.description: auto prefers the orthophoto, then point-cloud colours, then shaded relief computed from the elevation; each fills where the previous has no data.

texture_budget_mp.title: Total texture budget (megapixels, mesh workflow)
texture_budget_mp.description: Existing-model workflow: all texture atlases are shrunk uniformly until their decoded size fits this budget; 0 uses the quality profile's value (16 / 48 / 128 MP).

fill_holes.title: Fill holes
fill_holes.description: Fill missing elevation cells from the other elevation source (DTM under a DSM, point cloud under either) and interpolate small enclosed gaps. Large holes (outside the flight area, water) stay open.

point_classes.title: Point classes
point_classes.description: Comma-separated LAS classification codes to use from the point cloud (e.g. 2 for ground, 2,6 for ground and buildings). Empty uses all points.

point_statistic.title: Point surface statistic
point_statistic.description: point-cloud workflow: elevation per grid cell — max is a DSM-like top surface, mean is smoother, min approximates the ground.

max_points.title: Max points (points workflow)
max_points.description: Evenly subsample the cloud to at most this many points; 0 uses the quality profile's value (0.5M / 2M / 5M).

compression.title: Geometry compression
compression.description: draco compresses the mesh (the viewer decodes it; typically 5-10x smaller); none writes plain float32 buffers.
